mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( project_id, modifications, good_points, bad_points, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{modifications}, #{goodPoints}, #{badPoints}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, project_id AS projectId, modifications, good_points AS goodPoints, bad_points AS badPoints, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM reviews WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
